intro: Professionals and everyday users convert metric horsepower (PS) to kilowatts (kW) when working across metric and metric standards in automotive engine output ratings, electric motor sizing, solar inverter specifications, and appliance load planning. One horsepower (metric ps) equals 0.735499 kilowatts, while 1 kilowatt equals 1.359622 metric horsepower. Whether you are verifying power specifications on imported equipment, cross-checking technical datasheets, or scaling practical measurements, this converter applies the exact NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 reference relationship with instant precision.

faqs.question: How many kilowatts (kW) are in 1 horsepower (metric ps) (PS)?
faqs.answer: There are 0.73549875 kilowatts (kW) in 1 horsepower (metric ps) (PS), which rounds to 0.7355 kW for everyday calculations. Conversely, 1 kilowatt equals 1.359622 metric horsepower.

faqs.question: How do I convert metric horsepower to kilowatts (PS to kW)?
faqs.answer: To convert metric horsepower to kilowatts, use the formula: kW = PS × 0.73549875. For example, converting 10 PS gives 7.355 kW.

faqs.question: What is 10 metric horsepower in kilowatts?
faqs.answer: 10 metric horsepower (PS) equals exactly 7.355 kilowatts (kW) using standard NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 conversion factors.
